requirement: Warning deduplication and noise budget: same warning N+ times per interval aggregated with counter; success-on-unperformed-work escalated as B5-class failure. Warnings raised in [CRIT] zones are scored as failures unless explicitly resolved, including in test runs: a warning count above zero in a critical zone is a test failure, not noise. Incident classification applies a DEBUG-cap pre-filter before weighting, so DEBUG-level volume cannot dominate the corpus.
